title: unified-rollouts: add stability guards for canary/A-B/shadow auto-rollback
author: Priya Natarajan
ci_checks: integration-tests: pass after rerun (flaky shadow routing)
release_notes: Add conservative stability guards to unified rollouts to reduce noisy auto-rollbacks and prevent premature rollbacks for transient metric blips. Includes config flags for sensitivity and a new rollout-metrics dashboard.
description:
Motivation: We have seen several customer incidents where automated rollback logic triggered on transient metric spikes during canary/A-B/shadow rollouts (root cause: short-lived latency spikes and metric noise when traffic funnels across hosts). This PR introduces conservative stability guards and observability improvements to reduce false-positive auto-rollbacks while preserving safety for real regressions.

What this change does: 1) Introduces a two-stage evaluation window for auto-rollback: a short check for hard failures (5m) and a longer smoothing window (30m) for noisy metrics. 2) Adds a hysteresis threshold so a single metric breach does not immediately trigger rollback; a configurable number of consecutive windows must fail before action. 3) Implements metric-source blending: rollout decisions now consider both service-level error/latency metrics and model-quality signals (replay-based evals and a small sample of live golden prompts) to avoid punishing routing-induced latency. 4) Adds stability guard toggles and sensitivity presets (conservative, balanced, aggressive) that operators can set per-rollout. 5) Adds observability: rollout-metrics dashboard panels, event annotations for rollback reasons, and expanded tracing for canary shadow paths.

Files/areas touched: rollout controller and evaluator, policy config, telemetry/metrics ingestion, e2e tests, docs and console UI for sensitivity presets. Implementation focused on minimal runtime overhead and backwards-compatible defaults (default preset is "balanced" which preserves current behavior but reduces noise-induced rollbacks).

Testing: unit tests for evaluation logic, integration tests simulating noisy latency bursts and real regressions, and new e2e scenarios that run a canary then intentionally induce a real quality regression to validate rollback occurs promptly. Ran internal perf-canary harness for 48h with no increase in decision latency.

Rollout plan: feature-flag gated on rollout config level. Gradual rollout to internal staging for 72h, then staged enablement for 10% of production accounts (low-risk customers) for 7 days before full-enabling. Metrics to watch: rollback_rate, mean_time_to_rollback_for_true_regressions, false_positive_rate_of_auto_rollback, sample_eval_latency.

Related: ENG-4321 (reduce noisy rollbacks), ENG-4410 (add model-quality signals to rollback decisions), SUP-1287 (customer incident postmortem).

merge_commit: f6a7b44 - squash: unified rollouts stability guards
merge_notes: Merged after 3 approvals and CI green. Feature gated and will be rolled out by SRE per rollout plan.
observability_notes: New Grafana dashboard imported (dashboards/rollout-metrics.json). Added rollout event annotations and tracing for shadow path. Alert thresholds added: RolloutAutoRollbackSpike and RolloutFalsePositiveRate.
testing_summary: Unit tests: 74 new unit tests covering evaluator/hysteresis. Integration: simulated 100 noisy rollouts with 0.9% false-positive rate reduced from baseline 4.7%. E2E: verified correct rollback on seeded model-quality regression in 3/3 runs.
notes_for_release: Default preset is 'balanced' which reduces noisy rollbacks but preserves sensitivity to true regressions. Operators can select 'conservative' for high-safety customers. No breaking API changes.
ci_flaky_notes: integration-tests needed one rerun due to intermittent shadow routing race; mitigated by tightened routing handoff in evaluator and additional integration assertion. CI now stable.
backout_plan: Feature flag off immediately disables stability guards and returns to previous rollback logic. SRE runbook updated with commands to toggle per-tenant config. Rollback to previous code path requires normal release procedures.
security_review: security-scan passed; no new data exfil vectors introduced. Model-quality sampling limited and sampled payloads are hashed and stored with retention policy.
